description: Setas OS domain tokens. Structural semantics for field cultivation, data provenance, synchronization and lot lifecycle.

measured.label: MEASURED
measured.description: Direct sensor or instrument measurement (e.g. SCD30 CO2 sensor, physical scale).

calculated.label: CALCULATED
calculated.description: Derived mathematically from measured inputs (e.g. biological efficiency, dry matter).

estimated.label: ESTIMATED
estimated.description: Interpolated or estimated parameter (e.g. projected flush yield date).

target.label: TARGET
target.description: Set-point or recipe target (e.g. optimal 18.5°C room setpoint).

manual.label: MANUAL
manual.description: Manually entered operator measurement or field observation.

pending.label: PENDING
pending.description: Measurement awaiting sensor response or operator verification.

quarantine.label: CUARENTENA
quarantine.description: Batch isolated due to contamination risk or out-of-spec telemetry.
